faqSubtitle: Answers to common questions about GTA Casino Tools
faqAnswer1: GTA Casino Tools is designed for people interested in gambling from an analytical perspective.
faqQuestion2: How does the poker calculator work?
faqAnswer2: The poker calculator uses the Monte Carlo method to simulate 25,000 random deals and calculate the probability of your hand winning against the specified number of opponents.
faqQuestion3: In which languages is the site available?
faqAnswer3: The site supports three languages: Russian, English, and Spanish. Language switching is available in the upper right corner of each page.
faqQuestion4: Is the site optimized for mobile devices?
faqAnswer4: Yes, all tools are fully adapted for use on smartphones and tablets.
